title: Readiness copy handles, blocking FilterBar wire, entity resolver
description: wireReadinessCopyHandles copies data-rcf-copy-text through the shared toast (navigator.clipboard with a textarea fallback) - no command text in copy strings (AC-18003-5). wireReadinessBlockingFilterBar applies the stage/persona hiddens on data-rcf-stage / data-rcf-persona rows (AC-18003-3 filter). findByReadinessEntity resolves #tab=readiness&...&entity=<itemId> onto a non-document row carrying data-rcf-entity (AC-18003-2).
